title: Proof Broker rewrite trace (spec v1.0 §5.6)
description: Ordered log of IR-to-IR transformations performed by the rewriter. Consumed in reverse during lifting to invert each pass back through to the original goal. Trace completeness is a soundness obligation on each pass.

initial_ir_hash.description: Hash of the IR document before any rewriting (the serializer's output).

final_ir_hash.description: Hash of the IR document after the last successful pass; matches the certificate's dispatch_context_hash.

configuration.description: Pipeline configuration this trace was produced under (mirrors spec §5.3).
Pass configuration as supplied (subset of the pass's configuration_schema).

inversion_data.description: Pass-specific data sufficient for the lifting phase to invert this rewrite without consulting the source proof state. Trace-completeness obligation: every pass must record enough here that its inversion is purely local.

outcome.description: Outcome of running the pass. 'no_op' means preconditions met but no changes were made; 'failed' means an internal pass error occurred (and after_hash equals before_hash).

diagnostics.description: Optional human-readable note (e.g. why a pass was skipped or why it errored).
